TARGET.statement: For every prefix of the frozen HPS rank-1 random-swap factorization used to represent the edge permutations of an r-cover of the exact STS31 Levi base, determine whether an exact quantity sufficient to select a child preserving the common-interlacing largest-root bound can be computed deterministically in time polynomial in the encoded output size.

CAPTAIN_OBVIOUS_MINIMUM_INFORMATION_QUES.question: Do we truly need the complete conditional expected characteristic polynomial in order to choose a good child?

FROZEN_PARTIAL_SWAP_STATE_REPRESENTATION.cover_labeling_model: Each oriented base edge e carries sigma_e in S_r with sigma_-e=sigma_e^{-1}.
FROZEN_PARTIAL_SWAP_STATE_REPRESENTATION.factorization_model: Each uniform S_r label is represented using the HPS rank-1 random-swap factorization with at most binom(r,2) binary/constant-support swap decisions per base edge.
FROZEN_PARTIAL_SWAP_STATE_REPRESENTATION.canonical_decision_order: Base edges in the already frozen canonical oriented-edge order; within each edge, rank-1 swap factors in the exact HPS factorization order. A prefix is the first t decisions in this global order.

prefix_state.fixed_choices: the exact outcomes of the first t rank-1 swap decisions
prefix_state.unfixed_choices: all remaining rank-1 swap variables retain their prescribed independent HPS distributions
prefix_state.derived_partial_edge_labels: deterministically composed partial permutation operators induced by the frozen prefix
prefix_state.base_and_orientation: fixed and not part of the variable input

FROZEN_PARTIAL_SWAP_STATE_REPRESENTATION.forbidden_state_shortcut: A representation whose explicit state size is exponential/factorial in r is not an output-polynomial conditional algorithm.

EXACT_CONDITIONAL_OBJECT.primary_object: The conditional expectation, over all unfixed HPS swap variables, of the new-spectrum characteristic polynomial associated with the partially fixed cover-labeling state.
EXACT_CONDITIONAL_OBJECT.required_semantics: The object must be the exact HPS conditional average used by the common-interlacing descent, not an empirical sample, floating approximation, or unrelated surrogate.
EXACT_CONDITIONAL_OBJECT.acceptable_equivalent_object: Any exact equality-safe certificate C(s,child) whose correctness theorem proves that at least one explicitly identifiable child preserves the required parent largest-root bound and whose computation is polynomial in the frozen complexity measure.

BRANCH_SELECTION_OBLIGATION.good_child_semantics: A child whose conditional family retains the certified largest-root upper bound required by the HPS descent toward an HPS-good cover.

ALLOWED_CERTIFICATE_CLASSES.requirement: Compute p_s(x) exactly with a representation whose construction, coefficient bit length, and comparison procedure are polynomially bounded.
Compute exact data sufficient to prove that a specified child has largest conditional root no larger than the parent bound, with equality handled explicitly.
Use an exact potential with a proved implication to the common-interlacing largest-root inequality and a proved good-child preservation theorem.
Maintain a polynomial-size exact state updated per swap, together with a theorem showing that the state suffices to identify a good child.

COMPLEXITY_MEASURE.cover_encoding_size: Theta(r log r) to Theta(r polylog r) under explicit sheet/permutation labels; exact convention must be stated by any proof algorithm, and polynomial-in-r is sufficient for this fixed-base preregistration only when all produced integers/rationals/algebraic certificates have polynomial bit length.
COMPLEXITY_MEASURE.runtime_target: r^O(1) bit operations with exponent independent of r
COMPLEXITY_MEASURE.memory_target: r^O(1) bits unless an alternative polynomial-space encoding is proved
COMPLEXITY_MEASURE.coefficient_requirement: Any exact polynomial or rational/algebraic representation used by the selector must have degree and coefficient/certificate bit length polynomial in r.

EQUALITY_AND_TIE_HANDLING.rule: Equality is admissible whenever the HPS Ramanujan condition and the relevant interlacing inequality are non-strict; the algorithm must not reject a valid equality branch due to numerical approximation.
EQUALITY_AND_TIE_HANDLING.exactness: All branch decisions involving equality, sign, or root ordering must use exact algebraic/rational certificates or a rigorously bounded representation that resolves the required predicate.
EQUALITY_AND_TIE_HANDLING.multiple_good_children: Choose the first good child in the frozen deterministic child order once goodness is exactly certified.
EQUALITY_AND_TIE_HANDLING.unresolved_comparison: If the method cannot resolve a required equality/root predicate within its claimed polynomial bound, the gate remains OPEN rather than guessing.

sources.bound_use: Existence of Ramanujan r-covers for connected bipartite bases; real-rooted conditional averages/common-interlacing descent; rank-1 random-swap factorization cited by the parent gate.

sources.bound_use: Example that some interlacing families admit efficiently computable deterministic selection in a different construction framework.

sources.bound_use: Alternative polynomial-time biregular Ramanujan graph construction neighborhood.

sources.bound_use: Top-coefficient/largest-root approximation neighborhood relevant to possible weaker certificates.

SOURCE_BINDINGS_BASELINE.source_refresh_rule: Before any theorem, novelty, openness, or impossibility promotion, TOPA must re-check later literature specifically for fixed-base HPS conditional expectations, algorithmic interlacing, partial-permutation representation theory, and exact branch certificates.

PASS_FULL_POLYNOMIAL_ROUTE: Exact conditional polynomial semantics proved for every reachable prefix.
Deterministic polynomial-bit algorithm computes it for every reachable prefix.
A polynomial-bit exact comparison/selection rule identifies a good child.
Iterating the rule through O(r^2) depth yields the required HPS-good cover labels.
All complexity bounds are polynomial in the frozen output encoding measure.
PASS_WEAKER_CERTIFICATE_ROUTE: An exact polynomial-size certificate strictly weaker than the full polynomial is formally defined.
A theorem proves the certificate is sufficient to identify a good child under common interlacing, including equality cases.
The certificate is deterministically computable and updatable in polynomial bit complexity at every reachable prefix.
The resulting full descent is deterministic and polynomial in output encoding size.

FAIL_AND_OPEN_CRITERIA.FAIL: Use FAIL only if a rigorous falsifier proves the preregistered conditional-node algorithm claim impossible under a precisely stated unconditional theorem or explicit complexity assumption and exact frozen encoding. A failed candidate algorithm is not a FAIL for the whole target.
FAIL_AND_OPEN_CRITERIA.OPEN: If no polynomial exact algorithm/certificate is proved and no rigorous falsifier closes the target, verdict remains OPEN_NO_PROOF_NO_FALSIFIER.

COMMISSURE_PROTOCOL.HRAiN_role: STRUCTURAL_CONTEXT: dependency DAG, exact invariants, counterexamples, low-complexity certificates, bit accounting, necessary-vs-convenient assumptions, attacks on every candidate.
COMMISSURE_PROTOCOL.iNaiHR_role: ASSOCIATIVE_CONTEXT: propose bridges only as OBJECT + EXACT_PROPERTY + WHICH_OBLIGATION_IT_MAY_SATISFY + WHAT_WOULD_FALSIFY_IT.

SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.ORIGIN: Current open edge = exact conditional-node evaluation after a partial HPS swap prefix.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.EXPLORE: Search only mechanisms that could compute or replace the exact conditional polynomial/certificate.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.MIRROR: Attack hidden exponential state, coefficient blowup, approximation drift, equality failure, and insufficient certificates.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.SOURCE: Bind every imported theorem exactly before proof authority is granted.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.RETURN: Translate every surviving mechanism to the exact frozen STS31/HPS prefix state.
SPIRAL_PROTOCOL.ORIGIN_PRIME: Remove metaphor and leave one formal algorithmic obligation.

NEXT_SINGLE_GATE.scope: Attempt to prove or rigorously falsify only the frozen conditional-node computation/branch-certificate target. Begin with minimum-information attack on the full-polynomial requirement, then source-bound and red-team every candidate. Do not execute automatically from this preregistration commit.
